name: megarag
description: Phase-by-phase builder for MegaRAG, a multimodal RAG app (documents, images, video, audio, knowledge graph, 5 query modes, streaming cited chat) on Next.js 16, Supabase pgvector, Gemini, Docling, and the Vercel Workflow SDK. Updated October 2026 from the December 2025 MegaRAG Build Prompts guide: dead embedding and model APIs replaced, hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval, RLS, and an evaluation phase added. Includes a tested schema migration.
